tonight.headline: Up 25.5 at midday — the rest of your lineup plays tonight and Monday
body: Bad news first: C.J. Stroud scored 23.0 on your bench in London, Wilson has 2.5 on two targets, and Taylor 8.6 — with Tyler Warren inactive and Seth McGowan still taking snaps. Rashee Rice is out and Josh Jacobs is not eligible until Week 7.
Nothing to change. Gay (14:25), Golden and Pickens (18:20) and Daniels (Monday) are all cleared; ESPN projects 136.8 to 98.0. Los Cachanillas' Jaylen Warren is splitting with Dowdle in Pittsburgh.

case.label: Why nothing
case.body: Every unplayed starter is off his final report (Raiders.com 16 Oct, Packers.com 16 Oct, Commanders.com 17 Oct); Lamb's clearance (Dallas Sports Journal 18 Oct) is already in Pickens's number.

case.label: The Stroud points
case.body: 23.0 on the bench is the price of a Monday quarterback. The projection said Daniels by 6.1; the rule is the projection, and the call is graded on Monday's result, not on Stroud's.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Golden or Pickens scratch at 16:50 — Worthy kicks off 14:25, so it could not be covered. A Daniels scratch Monday: uncoverable.

worthALook.lead: KEI returns dropped him at 07:55 UTC; he is on waivers until Wednesday 01:00 CDMX.

case.label: The player
case.body: Arizona's lead back this week with Jeremiyah Love ruled out (ankle); Bam Knight is the only other back (Fantasy Footballers 16 Oct). The wire screen gives him 80% of Love's vacated share.

case.label: Checked this run
case.body: AZCardinals.com 16 Oct: Allgeier starts today, Bam Knight backup; Love out, no IR discussion. Still on IPADE waivers until Wed 01:00 CDMX.

case.label: Why not a claim
case.body: Love is re-evaluated daily and Arizona say there is 'no discussion of IR' (TSN 16 Oct) — this is a handcuff while Love is out. A claim in IPADE drops you to last for the season, and STRATEGY forbids spending it on a patch or a handcuff. Tuten's Week 7 bye is already covered by Jacobs (eligible) and Gordon (back from bye).

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Love is ruled out for Week 7 or placed on IR and Jacobs's return is delayed by further discipline — then reconsider Tuesday with the drop named.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love misses Weeks 7-8 and Allgeier, unclaimed, outscores Gordon in both.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The tool flags eight risers because its weakest movable back is Josh Jacobs — exempt-list zeros, not a role — and its weakest receiver is Rice, ruled out. None is a move: Jacobs is eligible in Week 7, Worthy already covers Rice, and priority never resets. Five weeks of data — still thin.
